facts: R.V. Samudra Ratnakar was equipped with deep/shallow multibeam, sub-bottom profiler, 960-channel 6 km streamer multichannel seismic, marine magnetometer/gradiometer, marine gravimeter, ROV, SAS, underwater camera and a 30 m piston coring system.
Government of India explicitly stated that multichannel seismic can detect gas-hydrate-related BSR and that seabed manifestations such as pockmarks/cold seeps can be identified using SAS and ROV.
findings.firewall: This proves instrument capability of the vessel, not that MCS/SAS/ROV were deployed over the SR-004 depression in August 2014.

findings.interpretive_context: GSI authors explicitly described the depression as a pockmark/circular depression and said SAS-resolved morphology is useful for detailed studies related to gas venting.
findings.source: Varghese et al., Current Science 113(3), 2017, Synthetic Aperture Sonar image of seafloor
findings.effect_on_SR004: Demonstrates that the same GSI marine programme possessed first-hand ultra-high-resolution experience with kilometre-scale pockmark morphology shortly after SR-004. It weakens any argument that a 600 m circular depression is intrinsically too large to be a pockmark, but does not classify SR-004.

facts: K. G. Mohan is a coauthor of the 2016 SR-004 impact-crater correspondence and the 2017 GSI SAS pockmark note.
B. Gopakumar is a coauthor of the 2016 SR-004 impact-crater correspondence and the 2017 GSI SAS pockmark note.
findings.firewall: Author overlap does not imply that the authors later reclassified SR-004, nor that the Mangalore pockmark is genetically identical.

facts: The 2016 SR-004 paper explicitly states that proximity to an E-W fault suggests a possible pockmark origin that should be explored.
It recommends multichannel seismic profiling for subsurface configuration.
It recommends ROV re-examination for gas-venting structures and gas-chromatographic sediment examination for natural gas emanation.
It recommends additional multibeam east of the depression to look for nearby similar features.

updated_interpretation.statement: The decisive SR-004 question is no longer whether GSI had the technical means to distinguish impact from fluid escape; the vessel/programme demonstrably had appropriate MCS/SAS/ROV/coring capabilities. The unresolved issue is whether those capabilities were subsequently deployed across the exact SR-004 depression and where those data are archived.
